tasks.title: Spike: Identify auth-failure exception types in ONVIF session layer
tasks.notes: Auth failures produce generic FaultException (SOAP) or CommunicationException (network) — indistinguishable. No MessageSecurityException. SessionProcess catches all errors generically. Iteration in Task 2.1 must treat all failures as 'try next credential'. Finding documented in PLAN.md.

tasks.title: Create CredentialStore with DPAPI-encrypted persistence
tasks.notes: Created odm/odm.ui.views/core/CredentialStore.cs with DPAPI ProtectedData.Protect (CurrentUser scope). Added System.Security reference to csproj. Atomic write via temp file (R4 mitigation). Migrates legacy account.def.xml on first load.

tasks.title: Update AccountManager to use CredentialStore and support multi-credential iteration
tasks.notes: Removed old plain-XML Load/Save. Constructor now reads first credential from CredentialStore. Added GetAllCredentials() delegating to CredentialStore. Added SetCredentials(List<Account>) for bulk update. SetCurrentAccount now stores to CredentialStore when remember=true, with case-insensitive deduplication by username.

tasks.title: Verify Phase 1
tasks.notes: Build passed: msbuild odm.sln completed with 0 errors, 49 warnings (pre-existing). Fixed .NET 4.0 compatibility: changed IReadOnlyList<Account> to IList<Account>, added 'using utils;' to CredentialStore.cs for dbg class access.

tasks.title: Implement credential iteration in DeviceListViewModel
tasks.notes: Replaced single-credential SessionProcess with TrySessionWithCredentials/TryNextCredential that iterates all stored credentials (from AccountManager.GetAllCredentials) plus anonymous fallback. Added _deviceFactories dictionary to track per-device NvtSessionFactory for correct credential propagation when device is selected. Updated ManualSessionProcess with same iteration pattern. Updated OnSelectedDeviceChanged and DeviceSelectedPublish to use per-device factory.

tasks.title: Per-device credential cache (in-memory)
tasks.notes: Added _credentialCache Dictionary<string, Account> keyed on device host (case-insensitive). Cache is consulted before full credential iteration — on hit, cached credential is tried first. On cache hit failure, entry is evicted and full iteration runs. Cache populated on every successful credential match. Cache survives Refresh (not cleared) for app-lifetime persistence; _deviceFactories cleared on Refresh since DeviceDescriptionHolder objects are recreated. Both discovered and manual devices use cache.
